note: Data is expressed in constant 2024 US$. Projects that target climate as a secondary objective are counted at their full value. In 2010, around a third of projects were not screened for climate objectives; since 2014, this unscreened share has been less than 10%.
title: Foreign aid given for climate as a main or secondary objective
subtitle: Committed bilateral [official development assistance (ODA)](#dod:oda) covered by the OECD's climate tracking, by whether climate change mitigation or adaptation is the main or secondary objective of the project. This data is expressed in US dollars and adjusted for inflation.
